keyFindings.description: sample.go:317: a sample whose reads failed after ctx ended is appended unmarked with PGTotal 0, Goroutines 0 and an empty NATS map; summarizeResources counts it as a good read, so pg_conns_total and goroutines take a 0 and nats_in/out_msgs_per_s go negative (reproduced by both passes); reachable with -grace under 5 s or a Postgres read stalled until cancel. Keep no sample once ctx has ended; TestSamplerMarksNoReadThatFailedOnceTheStepEnded asserts the bug.
